questions.q: Why does the summary say an email list is so valuable?
a: You own the contact information and can reach people directly
Email is the only free marketing channel available
Subscribers always buy on the very first message
Email lists grow quickly without any effort
questions.why: Lesson 1 says platforms can close your account, but your list stays yours.

a: A page with two choices: join the list for a gift or leave
A long sales page filled with customer testimonials
A blog archive listing all your older posts
A checkout page offering several products at once
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes the simple opt-in page that starts a list.

questions.q: What does the summary recommend for a pre-launch?
a: Three valuable pieces of content spaced two to three days apart
Daily discount codes for an entire week
One long email sent on launch day
A silent countdown with no content at all
questions.why: Lesson 2 says this builds anticipation the way a movie trailer does.

a: Selling an idea to a small list before building the product
Launching to thousands of strangers all at once
Testing a finished product after a year of development
Giving a product away free to collect reviews
questions.why: Lesson 3 says you build only after enough people pay for the idea.

questions.q: How large a list does the summary suggest for a seed launch?
a: Fewer than 100 people
About 1,000 people
At least 10,000 people
Exactly 500 people
questions.why: Lesson 3 says to approach people one-on-one and build a very small list first.
